Intended Use:
Diabetes Cockpit is a tool for analyzing, visualizing, and displaying data related to diabetes. It provides an overview of aggregated data from Apple Health or NightScout, and is separated into 5 sections: Today, Metrics, Trends, Insights, and Chat. All units and ranges provided in the app are determined by the user, and the app does not interpret or medically judge any of the available data.
Diabetes Cockpit is not a medical device and shall not be used to gather or provide medical advice nor aid in diagnosis or therapeutic decision making.
